name: toollib-build-vendor
description: Bundles the libraries behind Toollib's services into vendor/git.js, vendor/search.js and vendor/katex/katex.js.

scripts.build: npm run build:git && npm run build:search && npm run build:katex
scripts.build:katex: esbuild entry-katex.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020,safari15 --legal-comments=none --outfile=out/katex/katex.js && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css out/katex/ && mkdir -p out/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 out/katex/fonts/ && cp node_modules/katex/LICENSE out/katex/
